case_number: Civil Appeal No. 7605 of 2022 (@ Special Leave Petition (C) No.25303 of 2019)

parties.respondent: The National Insurance Co. Ltd. & Anr.

summary: Appeal against compensation quantum awarded by Madras High Court for severe motor accident injuries sustained at age two. High Court allowed claim dismissed on technical grounds by Tribunal, assessed Rs. 13,34,000 as compensation considering 100% disability. Appellant sought enhancement citing inadequate award under loss of earnings, disability, and non-pecuniary heads. Supreme Court considered medical board's 100% disability certification, appellant's lifelong physical impairment, and 'just compensation' requirement under Motor Vehicles Act, 1988. Application of precedents Philipps v. London & South Western Railway Co. and Kajal v. Jagdish Chand emphasized full and fair compensation for irreversible injuries.
legal_provisions_cited: Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988
Philipps v. London & South Western Railway Co.
final_judgment: Enhancement of quantum of compensation requested; Court to determine whether Rs. 13,34,000 was adequate given 100% disability and lifelong impairment requiring final full compensation as per MV Act.
